name: Procrastination
overview: Scripture warns against procrastination by illustrating the dangers of delay in responding to God's call and fulfilling vows. For example, Genesis 19:16 shows how Lot's lingering nearly cost him his safety, while Exodus 8:10 and Esther 5:8 depict postponement in critical moments. The command in Exodus 22:29 and Deuteronomy 23:21 to promptly offer firstfruits and fulfill vows emphasizes that delaying obedience is sinful. Believers are encouraged to seek God immediately, as Psalms 27:8 teaches, underscoring the urgency of the present moment in honoring God and living faithfully.
